title: goal_questions drops a numbered question's own words before its colon as a lead-in, so researched packs only the list after it
goal: SP-rsmmwzr2 close: ST-unrlktke's question '(4) What token cost does coordination add: agent teams, subagent briefs and the summaries they return?' was read by researched as 'agent teams, subagent briefs and the summaries they return?', since bl_land.goal_questions' question() drops any text of up to QUESTION_LEAD_WORDS words before ': ' even when that text is the question itself; the orchestrator had the goal reworded on the worker's branch. A piece whose text before ': ' is itself the question (it starts with a question word or holds the clause's verb) keeps it.
